summary: 1-story 1978 office, ~40 occupants. Fire reported Charlie side with black smoke; one trapped occupant reported in Storage 302. Print shop solvents and a possible gas leak.

hazards.text: Print shop tenant: solvents and inks in Suite 302.
Solar panels on roof, side C half. May stay energized; limits vertical ventilation.
Storage 302 has one door and the highest maze score.

entry_points.text: Main entrance, 1.8 m double door into lobby.
Rear door at end of hallway, 4 m from Storage 302.

ladder_positions.text: Roof 5 m; ground ladder from front parking lot.

search_plan.reason: Reported trapped occupant; closest to fire.
